scope: Inland Empire Swimming meets: October 10, 2025–October 10, 2026 (30 past meets plus today’s SWAT Fall Challenge)

evidence.method: Official Inland Empire Swimming public event archive and upcoming listings, filtered by date; event descriptions checked for cancellations and corrections. Official attachment lists retain announcement and result links.
evidence.coverage: 31 meet records. Excludes governance meetings, three canceled meets, and meets beginning after October 10. Today’s October 10–11 meet is retained as a whole event, not marked completed.
evidence.limitations: Covers the official LSC event listings; not an exhaustive search of separately observed school meets or every club time trial. Results links are attached, not individual swimmer results imported.
evidence.duplicateCheck: Compared stable IDs and existing published meet records; no published meet records were present.
corrections: TCCC Winter Invite: Jan 31–Feb 1, not Jan 24–25; corroborated by sanctioned announcement.
Junior Championships: Cougar Aquatics at WSU Gibb Pool after Moses Lake pool failure.
Pendleton Open: July 4–5 in event archive, not July 3–5 in master calendar.
Vandal Invitational Dec 5–7, 2025 canceled in event description although cancellation absent from title.

evidence.eventDescription: ***Zipped Results File & PDFs are posted below*** UPDATE 02/07/26 Coaches, Due to a sudden mechanical failure, the Moses Lake Pool is no longer available to host the upcoming, Junior Championship Meet . The IES Technical Planning Committee has met and reviewed available options so that we can still offer this meet on February 13th-15th. The request was made of Cougar Aquatics and they have agreed to host the meet at Gibb Pool at WSU , despite extremely short notice. Teams will be allowed to update their entries with no penalty. The deadline for sending in your new Jr Champs entries is Monday, February 9th at 9pm. A revised Meet Announcement is posted below. The Coaches Zoom Meeting will be held Tuesday, February 10th @ 7:30 pm. Please contace me or the IES Office iesoffice@ieswim.org for the meeting link. Thank you for your understanding and flexibility given this very challenging circumstance. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact me. Tia Pollick Championship Coordinator swimofficemom@gmail.com 509-554-3298

evidence.eventDescription: ***Zipped Results Files & PDF copies are posted below*** UPDATE -- 02/25/2026: Coaches, Due to the AMAZING number of Senior athletes we will be recognizing this year (close to 40), we have made an executive decision to adjust a few things so everyone is not at the pool an extra hour Saturday. We have also decided it best to be consistent throughout all three days, so the following changes have been made. CHANGE #1 — We will now be presenting the medals to the TOP 3 14&U places, IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING EACH 14&U CHAMPIONSHIP HEAT . We have done this previous years, and also did it very similarly at this past Jr Championship Meet. CHANGE #2 — Please fill out the attached Excel Spreadsheet with the following information for each Senior that will be recognized from your team. Once filled out, please return it to me . Our Announcer, Robert Broyles, will do all the talking. He will cover the information gathered from the spreadsheet. Athletes will still be paraded along the outside of the pool, starting at Clerk of Course, and coaches will congratulate and present a rose to each Senior Athlete, at the Start end of the pool. This should help us get through recognizing all 40+ athletes in a timely manner. CHANGE #3 — The FINALS START TIME ON SATURDAY has been moved to 5:10pm. The end time of competition will now be 7:37pm. CHANGE #4 — We will present the IES Senior Scholarship Recipients BEFORE starting the Senior Recognition. Please find the attached UPDATED documents -- PLEASE pass these along to your families! UPDATED Heat Sheet ( CLICK HERE ) UPDATED Schedule of Events ( CLICK HERE ) General Meeting Slides ( CLICK HERE) Senior Recognition Excel Spreadsheet ( CLICK HERE ) UPDATES -- 02/23/26: 1. IMPORTANT DOCUMENTS — The following items are attached below: Timeline by Session Schedule of Events Warmup Lane Assignments Team Lane Timing Assignments Psych Sheet 2. LANE TIMER SIGNUPS LINK — CLICK HERE 3. MEET APPAREL — Our apparel vendor would like to invite families to PRE-ORDER Champs shirts & hoodies by shopping at the Online Meet Store (see link below). The deadline for Pre-Orders is FEBRUARY 24th . https://www.twallawalla.com/ ies-2026-sc-championships ********************************************************************************************** The sanctioned meet announcement and meet entry files have been posted.
